title: Cell proliferation suppressor RBR1 interacts with ARID1 to promote pollen mitosis via stabilizing DUO1 in Arabidopsis.
authors: Li, Lei; Hu, Qianqian; Zhao, Yi; Jiang, Ting; Yang, Huaihao; Zheng, Binglian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥中RBR1与ARID1互作稳定转录因子DUO1以调控花粉有丝分裂，虽涉及转录因子DUO1，但核心是细胞周期与蛋白稳定性调控，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题方法轴和互作轴均不匹配。
abstract: In plants, sperm cell formation involves two rounds of pollen mitoses, in which the microspore initiates the first pollen mitosis (PMI) to produce a vegetative cell and a generative cell, then the generative cell continues the second mitosis (PMII) to produce two sperm cells. DUO1, a R2R3 Myb transcription factor, is activated in the generative cell to promote S-G2/M transition during PMII. Loss-of-function of DUO1 caused a complete arrest of PMII. Despite the importance of DUO1, how DUO1 is regulated is largely unexplored. We previously demonstrated that ARID1, an ARID transcription factor, stimulates DUO1 transcription. Here, we show that cell proliferation suppressor RBR1 interacts with ARID1 to stabilize DUO1. While the C-terminus of RBR1 is dispensable for vegetative growth, it plays a crucial role in reproductive development and facilitates interaction with ARID1. Moreover, DUO1 is a short-lived protein, ARID1 promotes the RBR1-DUO1 interaction, and RBR1 stabilizes DUO1 in a proteasome-dependent manner. Thus, RBR1 promotes DUO1-dependent PMII progression via antagonizing its repressive role in the cell cycle factors CDKA;1 and CYCB1;1. Collectively, we uncover that ARID1 and RBR1 act in concert to regulate DUO1 at both the transcriptional and posttranscriptional levels, balancing cell specification and cell division.
abstract_zh: 在植物中，精子细胞的形成涉及两轮花粉有丝分裂，其中小孢子启动第一次花粉有丝分裂（PMI）产生一个营养细胞和一个生殖细胞，随后生殖细胞继续进行第二次有丝分裂（PMII）产生两个精子细胞。DUO1，一种R2R3 Myb转录因子，在生殖细胞中被激活，以促进PMII期间的S-G2/M转变。DUO1的功能缺失导致PMII完全停滞。尽管DUO1的重要性，其调控机制在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们先前证明ARID1，一种ARID转录因子，刺激DUO1的转录。在此，我们展示细胞增殖抑制因子RBR1与ARID1相互作用以稳定DUO1。虽然RBR1的C端对营养生长非必需，但它在生殖发育中发挥关键作用，并促进与ARID1的相互作用。此外，DUO1是一种短寿命蛋白，ARID1促进RBR1-DUO1相互作用，且RBR1以蛋白酶体依赖方式稳定DUO1。因此，RBR1通过拮抗其在细胞周期因子CDKA;1和CYCB;1中的抑制作用，促进DUO1依赖的PMII进程。总之，我们揭示ARID1和RBR1协同作用，在转录和转录后水平调控DUO1，平衡细胞特化和细胞分裂。
